ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the length of segment $AB$ is $10\, \text{cm}$. Point $C$ is a point on segment $AB$ with $BC=3\, \text{cm}$. Points $D$ and $E$ are the midpoints of segments $AC$ and $AB$, respectively. Find the length of segment $DE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that point $C$ lies on the segment $AB$, with segment $AB$ measuring $10cm$, and $BC=3cm$,\\
therefore, $AC=AB−BC=10−3=7cm$,\\
since point $D$ is the midpoint of $AC$,\\
thus $AD=\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}\times 7=\frac{7}{2}$cm;\\
since point $E$ is the midpoint of $AB$,\\
thus $AE=\frac{1}{2}AB=\frac{1}{2}\times 10=5$cm,\\
hence $DE=AE−AD=5−\frac{7}{2}=\boxed{\frac{3}{2}}$cm.
